description: Look up where a text sent with send_sms or send_sign_in_code is now, by its messageId: pending (waiting for the phone), sent, delivered, failed, or unconfirmed (handed to the SIM, but the phone got no confirmation, so it may have gone out). Returns the status with its times and any error. Read-only. Never resend a failed or unconfirmed text on your own: ask the user.

messageId.description: The messageId that send_sms or send_sign_in_code returned.

name: get_message_status

status.description: pending, sent, delivered, failed or unconfirmed.

title: Check a text's status
